import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def a(text):
    logger.info("%s", text.strip())


def b(raw):
    logger.info("%s", raw.decode("utf-8"))


def c(reply):
    logger.info("%s", reply.lower())


def d(image_bytes):
    logger.info("%s", image_bytes.hex())


def e(text):
    logger.info("%s", text.format(1))
